== Notes ==
* The amount of energy regained is rounded; for example, a 5 energy spell returns 1+3=4 energy instead of 3{{1/2}} energy.
* When combined with one of the other attunements (e.g. [[Fire Attunement]]), 5 energy spells of the respective element can be cast for a net energy gain.
* When combined with [[Glyph of Lesser Energy]], energy is still refunded causing a net energy gain. This also applies to [[Glyph of Energy]], however as another elite it has less practical application.
